result.title: Probabilistic Forecasting of Wildfire Size Using Conditional Flow Matching
result.comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Code and data: https://github.com/isaaclee2/Wildfire_Size_Flow_Matching
result.summary: In this work we present a probabilistic model for predicting the temporal evolution of wildfire size using conditional generative algorithms, namely flow matching. Rather than predicting spatially resolved fire progression, the proposed model forecasts a time series of fire acreage, substantially reducing computational cost and enabling efficient integration with downstream applications such as early warning systems and risk assessment tools. Given estimates of the fire size at the current and previous forecasting steps, alongside spatially averaged weather conditions, terrain characteristics, and fuel composition, the model predicts the change in fire area over a 3-hour interval. Training data are drawn from 140 coupled atmosphere-wildfire simulations generated using WRF-SFIRE, paired with weather data from the North American Mesoscale (NAM) model. Sensitivity analysis demonstrates that the model captures physically-consistent responses to variations in wind speed, temperature, and relative humidity. Model performance is evaluated against reference solutions from WRF-SFIRE. For single-step predictions, the model achieves a symmetric mean absolute percentage error (sMAPE) of 0.39 relative to the reference WRF-SFIRE solutions. Recursive multi-step predictions over 24 hours are performed for 12 held-out test cases, where the flow matching model achieves a final fire area sMAPE of 0.39 while further providing meaningful quantification of forecast uncertainty.

AI.brief_summary: 该文用条件 flow matching 对野火面积的时间演化做概率预测：以当前与上一步火场规模、区域平均气象、地形与燃料信息为条件，预测 3 小时面积变化，并对 24 小时多步递归预报给出不确定性量化。
AI.relevance_reason: flow matching 式的连续时间生成、递归多步状态推进及不确定性量化，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的生成与逐步更新提供方法线索，其敏感性分析思路也可供核查 latent 表示是否保留任务必要信息；但属跨领域应用，迁移性待验证。
